description: Maxim MAX17048 — I2C LiPo fuel gauge with ModelGauge algorithm, no sense resistor needed. TDFN-8 package. Reports % SOC, voltage, and charge rate from a single cell.
name: max17048
watch_out_for: I2C addr 0x36. ModelGauge needs a quick-start or relaxed battery after insertion for accuracy; ALRT is open-drain (pull-up).
